messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile-friendly 2D game themed around “calamity wrath of the gods.”

## Requirements
- Build now without clarification; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them at completion.
- Save screenshots used for checks as small JPEGs, viewport no wider than 1280px, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created an original celestial boss-rush game, “Wrath of the Gods — Astral Calamity,” with keyboard and touch controls.
- Implemented a moving boss, aimed auto-fire, timed vulnerability windows, three attack phases, dash, and Nova bullet-clearing ability.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a playable canvas game, title/results screens, responsive mobile controls, HUD, and original canvas-drawn visuals.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Checked desktop and mobile screenshots; most recent `/tmp/opencode/wrath-mobile-active.jpg` shows the mobile game active.

### Active
- No active edits; game implementation is ready for further review.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Optionally perform a final playability check, including boss defeat and loss/retry paths.
2. Summarize the finished game and note the assumption that this is an original game inspired by the requested theme.

Storage:
  state-load <filename>       loads browser storage (authentication) state from a file

  cookie-list                 list all cookies (optionally filtered by domain/path)

  cookie-set <name> <value>   set a cookie with optional flags
